Operation guaranteed even in the absence of connectivity, with periodic remote synchronization. The app complies with the regulations in force for the soft-air game for long and short range patrols.

Invitation via E-Mail, which allows all team operators to access the tournament as participants.

It is possible to associate a referee and a score on the objectives, with the combination of one or more secondary objectives of the action type; it will also be possible to indicate the presence of a window of engagement, validity and visibility.
